title: Shared definitions
description: Types shared by the chain, meal-deal and manifest schemas.

slug.description: A lower-case identifier made of letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. "chicken-club-wrap".

calendarDay.description: A date without a time, YYYY-MM-DD.

region.description: ISO 3166 codes: England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, Ireland.

dietTag.description: Only what the chain's own information states. "dairy-free" is a preference tag, never an allergen claim.

reviewStatus.description: "draft" until a person has checked every figure against the source. Release bundles contain verified data only.

gramsOrUnpublished.description: Grams, or null when the source doesn't publish this figure.

gtin.description: A GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13 or GTIN-14 barcode. The validator also checks the check digit.
